props.name: mode
props.description: Enable the selection of a single day, multiple days, or a range of days.

props.name: required
props.description: Whether the selection is required.

props.name: className
props.description: Class name to add to the root element.

props.name: classNames
props.description:
Change the class names used by DayPicker.

Use this prop when you need to change the default class names — for
example, when importing the style via CSS modules or when using a CSS
framework.

props.name: modifiersClassNames
props.description: Change the class name for the day matching the `modifiers`.

props.name: style
props.description: Style to apply to the root element.

props.name: styles
props.description: Change the inline styles of the HTML elements.

props.name: modifiersStyles
props.description: Change the class name for the day matching the modifiers.

props.name: id
props.description: A unique id to add to the root element.

props.name: defaultMonth
props.description:
The initial month to show in the calendar.

Use this prop to let DayPicker control the current month. If you need to
set the month programmatically, use month and onMonthChange.

props.name: month
props.description:
The month displayed in the calendar.

As opposed to `defaultMonth`, use this prop with `onMonthChange` to change
the month programmatically.

props.name: numberOfMonths
props.description: The number of displayed months.

props.name: startMonth
props.description: The earliest month to start the month navigation.

props.name: endMonth
props.description: The latest month to end the month navigation.

props.name: pagedNavigation
props.description: Paginate the month navigation displaying the `numberOfMonths` at a time.

props.name: reverseMonths
props.description:
Render the months in reversed order (when numberOfMonths is set) to
display the most recent month first.

props.name: hideNavigation
props.description:
Hide the navigation buttons. This prop won't disable the navigation: to
disable the navigation, use disableNavigation.

props.name: disableNavigation
props.description:
Disable the navigation between months. This prop won't hide the navigation:
to hide the navigation, use hideNavigation.

props.name: captionLayout
props.description:
Show dropdowns to navigate between months or years.

- `label`: Displays the month and year as a label. Default value.
- `dropdown`: Displays dropdowns for both month and year navigation.
- `dropdown-months`: Displays a dropdown only for the month navigation.
- `dropdown-years`: Displays a dropdown only for the year navigation.

**Note:** By default, showing the dropdown will set the startMonth
to 100 years ago and endMonth to the end of the current year. You
can override this behavior by explicitly setting `startMonth` and
`endMonth`.

props.name: reverseYears
props.description:
Reverse the order of years in the dropdown when using
`captionLayout="dropdown"` or `captionLayout="dropdown-years"`.

props.name: navLayout
props.description:
Adjust the positioning of the navigation buttons.

- `around`: Displays the buttons on either side of the caption.
- `after`: Displays the buttons after the caption. This ensures the tab order
  matches the visual order.

If not set, DayPicker preserves its legacy layout, but the tab order may
not align with the visual order when using `captionLayout="dropdown"`.

props.name: fixedWeeks
props.description:
Display always 6 weeks per each month, regardless of the month’s number of
weeks. Weeks will be filled with the days from the next month.

props.name: hideWeekdays
props.description: Hide the row displaying the weekday row header.

props.name: showOutsideDays
props.description:
Show the outside days (days falling in the next or the previous month).

**Note:** when a broadcastCalendar is set, this prop defaults to
true.

props.name: showWeekNumber
props.description:
Show the week numbers column. Weeks are numbered according to the local
week index.

props.name: animate
props.description: Animate navigating between months.

props.name: broadcastCalendar
props.description:
Display the weeks in the month following the broadcast calendar. Setting
this prop will ignore weekStartsOn (always Monday) and
showOutsideDays will default to true.

props.name: ISOWeek
props.description:
Use ISO week dates instead of the locale setting. Setting this prop will
ignore `weekStartsOn` and `firstWeekContainsDate`.

props.name: timeZone
props.description:
The time zone (IANA or UTC offset) to use in the calendar (experimental).

See
[Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_tz_database_time_zones)
for the possible values.

props.name: noonSafe
props.description:
Keep calendar math at noon in the configured timeZone to avoid
historical second-level offsets drifting dates across midnight.

This prop sets the time of the dates to noon (12:00).

props.name: components
props.description: Change the components used for rendering the calendar elements.

props.name: footer
props.description:
Add a footer to the calendar, acting as a live region.

Use this prop to communicate the calendar's status to screen readers.
Prefer strings over complex UI elements.

props.name: autoFocus
props.description:
When a selection mode is set, DayPicker will focus the first selected day
(if set) or today's date (if not disabled).

Use this prop when you need to focus DayPicker after a user action, for
improved accessibility.

props.name: disabled
props.description:
Apply the `disabled` modifier to the matching days. Disabled days cannot be
selected when in a selection mode is set.

props.name: hidden
props.description:
Apply the `hidden` modifier to the matching days. Will hide them from the
calendar.

props.name: today
props.description:
The today’s date. Default is the current date. This date will get the
`today` modifier to style the day.

props.name: modifiers
props.description: Add modifiers to the matching days.

props.name: labels
props.description:
Labels creators to override the defaults. Use this prop to customize the
aria-label attributes in DayPicker.

props.name: formatters
props.description:
Formatters used to format dates to strings. Use this prop to override the
default functions.

props.name: dir
props.description:
The text direction of the calendar. Use `ltr` for left-to-right (default)
or `rtl` for right-to-left.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: The aria-label attribute to add to the container element.

props.name: aria-labelledby
props.description: The aria-labelledby attribute to add to the container element.

props.name: role
props.description: The role attribute to add to the container element.

props.name: nonce
props.description:
A cryptographic nonce ("number used once") which can be used by Content
Security Policy for the inline `style` attributes.

props.name: title
props.description: Add a `title` attribute to the container element.

props.name: lang
props.description:
Add the language tag to the container element.

When omitted, DayPicker uses the active locale code (`locale.code`). Set
this prop to override the language tag.

props.name: locale
props.default: enUS - The English locale default of `date-fns`.
props.description:
The locale object used to localize dates. Pass a locale from
`react-day-picker/locale` to localize the calendar.

props.name: numerals
props.description:
The numeral system to use when formatting dates.

- `latn`: Latin (Western Arabic)
- `arab`: Arabic-Indic
- `arabext`: Eastern Arabic-Indic (Persian)
- `deva`: Devanagari
- `beng`: Bengali
- `guru`: Gurmukhi
- `gujr`: Gujarati
- `orya`: Oriya
- `tamldec`: Tamil
- `telu`: Telugu
- `knda`: Kannada
- `mlym`: Malayalam

props.name: weekStartsOn
props.description:
The index of the first day of the week (0 - Sunday). Overrides the locale's
default.

props.name: firstWeekContainsDate
props.description: The day of January that is always in the first week of the year.

props.name: useAdditionalWeekYearTokens
props.description:
Enable `DD` and `DDDD` for week year tokens when formatting or parsing
dates.

props.name: useAdditionalDayOfYearTokens
props.description:
Enable `YY` and `YYYY` for day of year tokens when formatting or parsing
dates.

props.name: onMonthChange
props.description: Event fired when the user navigates between months.

props.name: onNextClick
props.description: Event handler when the next month button is clicked.

props.name: onPrevClick
props.description: Event handler when the previous month button is clicked.

props.name: onDayClick
props.description: Event handler when a day is clicked.

props.name: onDayFocus
props.description: Event handler when a day is focused.

props.name: onDayBlur
props.description: Event handler when a day is blurred.

props.name: onDayKeyDown
props.description: Event handler when a key is pressed on a day.

props.name: onDayMouseEnter
props.description: Event handler when the mouse enters a day.

props.name: onDayMouseLeave
props.description: Event handler when the mouse leaves a day.

props.name: dateLib
props.description:
Replace the default date library with a custom one. Experimental: not
guaranteed to be stable (may not respect semver).

props.name: selected
props.type: Date | undefined | Date[] | undefined | DateRange | undefined
props.description: The selected date.

props.name: onSelect
props.type: OnSelectHandler<Date | undefined> | undefined | OnSelectHandler<Date> | undefined | OnSelectHandler<Date[] | undefined> | undefined | OnSelectHandler<Date[]> | undefined | OnSelectHandler<DateRange | undefined> | undefined | OnSelectHandler<DateRange> | undefined
props.description: Event handler when a day is selected.

props.name: buttonVariant
props.description: Visual variant used for calendar navigation buttons.

props.name: min
props.description: The minimum number of selectable days.

props.name: max
props.description: The maximum number of selectable days.

props.name: excludeDisabled
props.description: When `true`, the range will reset when including a disabled day.

props.name: resetOnSelect
props.description:
When `true`, clicking a day starts a new range if there is no current start
date or if a range is already complete. In those cases, the clicked day
becomes the start of the new range. When `required` is `false`, clicking
the same day of a single-day range clears the selection.

props.name: day
props.description: The day to render.

props.name: modifiers
props.description: The modifiers to apply to the day.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Prevents user interaction.

props.name: name
props.description: Field name used in form data.

props.name: type
props.description: The native input or button behavior.

props.name: value
props.description: The current value when controlled by the application.

props.name: defaultChecked
props.description: Initial checked state for an uncontrolled control.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Initial value for an uncontrolled component.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional CSS classes merged with the component styles.

props.name: id
props.description: Unique identifier used to associate labels and descriptions.

props.name: children
props.description: Content rendered inside this component.

props.name: onFocus
props.description: Called when the control receives focus.

props.name: onBlur
props.description: Called when the control loses focus.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called when the underlying form control changes; inspect the event for its value.

props.name: onKeyDown
props.description: Called when a key is pressed while this element is focused.

props.name: onClick
props.description: Called when the element is activated.

props.name: locale
props.description: Locale used for date labels and formatting.
